rationale: The full-convergence run reproduced the lag (38,38,37,38,38) even with a loop that only stops once all decided indices agree, so the earlier resend-interval explanation is not established. Before treating this as a liveness defect, this diagnostic reruns the same schedule (run id 13) and samples node 3's accepted index, decided index, leader view, Accept flag, promise ballot and the number of times its accepted index changed during convergence. That distinguishes a missing AcceptSync (accepted stays short) from a Decide/sequence-number rejection (accepted complete, decided behind).

experiment.revision_reason: Adds diagnostics to the full convergence run: rounds_run, node 3's final accepted/decided, its leader pid and Accept flag, its promise ballot number, and how many times its accepted index changed during the 150 fair-delivery rounds. The randomized phase, seed, reconfigure step and comparisons are unchanged.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at 450 and 20 percent loss, run id 13; the 150-round convergence loop stops only when all decided indices agree and samples node 3's accepted/decided/leader/promise state.
assumptions: Ticking every node each round drives elections and resend timers; 150 rounds exceed the default 100-tick resend timeout.
Node 3 is the lagging follower identified by the previous runs.
No snapshots, trimming or starting the next configuration.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_converges_fully with run id 13. During the convergence loop count rounds_run and node 3 accepted-index changes; after it, emit the previous fields plus n3_accepted, n3_decided, n3_leader_pid, n3_accept, n3_promise_n, n3_accepted_changes and rounds_run.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
